architecture_decision_signals.classification: Inferred decision test; baseline is a modeling assumption, not an attributed prior forecast
architecture_decision_signals.baseline_under_test: Carry Q3 consolidated gross margin into the Q4 revenue plan.
architecture_decision_signals.new_evidence: Q4 management guidance: revenue $130bn +/-3%, extra week, gross margin 71–72%.
architecture_decision_signals.mechanism: Calendar length changes reported growth; the margin stepdown requires a separate mix and cost bridge. The reviewed sources do not quantify the cause of the Q4 decline.
architecture_decision_signals.affected_decision: Use a lower guided margin range and calendar-adjusted revenue sensitivity before extending rack procurement assumptions.
architecture_decision_signals.confidence: High on disclosed guidance; medium on demand interpretation.
architecture_decision_signals.next_falsifying_observation: A comparable-period shipment/usage series or an explicit Q4 margin reconciliation contradicting the assumed revenue pace or cost bridge.

architecture_decision_signals.baseline_under_test: Secured component supply is sufficient evidence of deployable output.
architecture_decision_signals.new_evidence: Supply/capacity commitments rose to $390bn from $279bn; management attributes most of the increase to multiyear memory procurement.
architecture_decision_signals.mechanism: Longer procurement commitments can secure allocation while leaving qualification, integration and powered-site timing unresolved.
architecture_decision_signals.affected_decision: Tie memory reservations to qualified output, rack acceptance and cancellation terms.
architecture_decision_signals.confidence: High on commitments; medium on the binding constraint.
architecture_decision_signals.next_falsifying_observation: Inventory converts to accepted systems on schedule, or commitments are reduced while output remains unchanged.

architecture_decision_signals.baseline_under_test: Recognized supplier revenue implies completed customer funding and cash collection.
architecture_decision_signals.new_evidence: Receivables $81.033bn; DSO 64 days versus 60. Guarantees have maximum gross exposure $118bn, with no payments reported as of the commentary.
architecture_decision_signals.mechanism: Payment terms and contingent support leave exposure after shipment. DSO changes alone do not establish impairment.
architecture_decision_signals.affected_decision: Track collections, financing conditions and site acceptance separately from booked revenue.
architecture_decision_signals.confidence: High on disclosure categories; medium on future credit effects.
architecture_decision_signals.next_falsifying_observation: Cash receipts normalize DSO and projects fund independently, or guarantee obligations are activated.
